description: The safe way to use this feature, and the reason nothing about draft handling needed to change: an editor duplicates a band, renames it, points it at a new card group, and leaves Draft ON while they fill the cards in. The copy sits in the list with its Draft chip, in sequence, under its own name — while the live /donate page still shows only the original band, because publishedEntries drops a drafted section before it ever reaches the renderer. So a half-built duplicate is invisible to visitors without the editor having to think about it. The draft sits in place rather than being hoisted into a separate group, since in a list that exists to show order, moving a row out of its position would misreport where the section actually sits on the page.
